title: Pelican Charter Life
style: 105 BPM warm coastal pop, NZ AU vocal lean, strummed acoustic guitar, slide guitar accents, soft brushed kick, ocean room ambience, gentle bass, light tambourine, gull and water sound texture, layered family-style harmonies on chorus, sunny salt-air feel, working-day pride, wide and open, no swearingsong
lyrics:
[Intro — acoustic guitar, ocean room, gull cry, soft kick]
Pelican Charter Life…
Pelican Charter Life…
Swan River to Rotto, the whole horizon wide

[Verse 1]
Pete on the helm, hand steady on the wheel
Reading the wind like a book he could feel
Brandon's tuned the engine 'til it purrs like a cat
Got the charts in the cabin, got the kettle on the mat

Family business, brother and his right-hand mate
Built it slow and clean, every detail straight
No shortcuts in the rigging, no cracks in the line
Pelican Charter Life — doing it fine

[Pre-Chorus]
Morning glass on the river, sun coming up
Coffee in a steel mug, refill the cup
Guests on the dock with their bags and their grins
The day's already won before the day begins

[Chorus]
Pelican Charter Life
Swan River wide, Indian Ocean bright
Pete on the helm, Brandon by his side
Pelican Charter Life
Rotto on the line, Perth coast on our side
Pelican Charter Life — the whole horizon wide

[Verse 2]
Quokka on the island, the sun starts to slow
Boat tucked in the bay where the calm waters go
Guests with their stories, their photos, their grins
This is the kind of day that the good year wins

No machines between us — human to human
Real hands on the rope, real eyes on the runway
The ocean don't care about your fancy talk
The ocean wants the work — and these brothers walk it

[Pre-Chorus]
Late sun on the river, soft pink light
Kettle on again, dinner's in sight
Log the day in the book, every line clean
Pelican Charter Life — best you've seen

[Chorus]
Pelican Charter Life
Swan River wide, Indian Ocean bright
Pete on the helm, Brandon by his side
Pelican Charter Life
Rotto on the line, Perth coast on our side
Pelican Charter Life — the whole horizon wide

[Bridge — stripped, gull and acoustic]
The river holds the city.
The ocean holds the river.
The boat holds the family.
The family holds the line.
Pelican Charter Life.

[Final Chorus]
Pelican Charter Life
Swan River wide, Indian Ocean bright
Pete on the helm, Brandon by his side
Pelican Charter Life
Rotto on the line, Perth coast on our side
Pelican Charter Life — the whole horizon wide

[Outro]
Pelican Charter Life…
Pete on the helm…
Brandon tuned it tight…
See you on the dock
